title: 3 Million Technical Talent (3MTT) Programme
organization: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation & Digital Economy / NITDA
description: National initiative to train 3 million technical talents across Nigeria in core technology domains including Software Development, Data Analysis, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, and AI.
eligibility: Nigerian citizens aged 18-35 residing in any of the 36 states or FCT; commitment to participate in hybrid learning courses and community hub sessions.

title: PTDF National Undergraduate Scholarship Scheme
description: Federal government scholarship providing tuition fees and annual living allowances to qualified full-time undergraduate students in Nigerian public universities pursuing petroleum, energy, and engineering disciplines.
eligibility: Full-time 200-level undergraduate students in Federal and State Universities in Nigeria with a minimum CGPA of 3.5 on a 5-point scale (or 3.0 on a 4-point scale) in relevant STEM courses.

title: MTN Foundation Science & Technology Scholarship (STS)
description: Annual academic scholarship worth N300,000 per academic year for high-performing Nigerian STEM students in public tertiary institutions until graduation.
eligibility: Full-time 200L or 300L students in public Nigerian Universities, Polytechnics, and Colleges of Education studying accredited STEM courses with a minimum CGPA of 3.5/5.0 or equivalent.

title: TotalEnergies / NNPC Joint Venture National Merit Scholarship
organization: TotalEnergies EP Nigeria / NNPC Joint Venture
description: Annual university scholarship supporting Nigerian undergraduates in recognized tertiary institutions, providing continuous financial grants through degree completion.
eligibility: Registered full-time 100L or 200L Nigerian students in accredited Nigerian universities with minimum SSCE credit requirements and proof of matriculation.

title: Federal Government Bilateral Education Agreement (BEA) Scholarships
organization: Federal Ministry of Education (Federal Scholarship Board)
description: Overseas government scholarship programme under bilateral educational agreements with partner countries (including Russia, Morocco, Hungary, and China) for undergraduate and postgraduate study.
eligibility: Undergraduate applicants require Five distinctions (A or B) in WAEC/NECO in relevant subjects including English and Maths. Postgraduate applicants require minimum 2nd Class Upper (2:1) degree.

title: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Gombe 2026: Open-Source AI Challenge
organization: Google Developer Groups & Open-Source Community Gombe
description: Collaborative hackathon event in Gombe bringing together students and developers to create impactful open-source AI applications, cloud data solutions, and community developer tools.
eligibility: Tertiary students, early-career developers, and tech enthusiasts in Gombe and northern Nigeria. Teams of 1 to 4 participants.

title: Interswitch Graduate Trainee Engineering Programme
description: Full-time intensive graduate engineering development program designed to train future payment infrastructure architects, software engineers, and product analysts.
eligibility: Graduates of Computer Science, Engineering, or related quantitative disciplines with minimum 2:1 degree; completion of mandatory NYSC; maximum 26 years of age.

title: Shell Petroleum Development Company (SPDC) JV University Scholarship
organization: The Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited
description: Two-category annual scholarship scheme (National Merit and Areas of Operation) providing continuous financial grants to university undergraduates in Nigerian universities.
eligibility: Full-time 100-level Nigerian undergraduates in accredited universities with minimum 7 O'level credits including English and Mathematics; not currently a beneficiary of another corporate scholarship.

title: Google Africa Developer Scholarship (GADS)
description: Pan-African scholarship providing free access to Pluralsight skill assessments, curated learning tracks, and certification preparation in Android Development, Cloud Engineering, and Agile Architecture.
eligibility: Individuals aged 18+ residing in Sub-Saharan African countries including Nigeria, with access to a computer and internet connection.

title: Flutterwave Product & Engineering Student Internship
description: Six-month structured internship program offering hands-on mentorship, software feature deployment, and API platform scaling experience for aspiring engineers.
eligibility: Current undergraduate students or recent graduates with working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, or Go, and demonstrated passion for fintech infrastructure.

title: Andela Learning Community (ALC) Technical Upskilling
description: Virtual technical training accelerator focusing on web development, mobile software, and data engineering pathways supported by community mentors and peer learning circles.
eligibility: Open to African developers and students at beginner to intermediate levels; self-driven learners with weekly commitment of 10-15 hours.

title: Nigerian Breweries Graduate & Technical Trainee Scheme
description: Multi-month technical development scheme providing vocational engineering, plant operations, and industrial automation training across operating breweries.
eligibility: Holders of OND / HND / BSc in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical Engineering, or related disciplines; completion of NYSC where applicable.

title: Northern Tech Mentorship & Hardware Grant Initiative
description: Community-sourced lead for laptop subsidies and mentorship. Official sponsor documentation is pending verification.
eligibility: Students in northern Nigerian tertiary institutions.
